Quick triage notes (15m):
- Initial observation: tail ops concentrated on hosts 12/13/14 serving model-rdx-7b-q4. CPU utilization normal, GPU SM stalls increased for long-seq requests. Looks like a small subset of requests are hitting much longer decode loops (likely client-side prompting variance).
- Error rates are flat; no OOMs. KV cache hit rate dropped ~8% in the same window.
- Safe immediate mitigation: enable routing policy to route Checkoutly traffic matching /checkout endpoint to model-rdx-7b-lite (lower latency, slightly less throughput per-dollar). This avoids touching global infra. Expected p99 reduction to ~400-500ms within one propagation window (1-2 minutes) but model-quality delta must be communicated.
- Risk: increased token cost and potential minor semantic differences for edge-case prompts. Rollback: revert routing if errors increase >0.2% or customer reports regressions.
